notes: The player is addressed with the respectful plural ku (kuna, kun, -ku); singular ka/ki would state a gender. Buttons use the ungendered bare imperative (Gina, Inganta, Karɓa).

No ya/ta (he/she) for a player or a placeholder: rephrased with nouns, impersonal an-sentences or a colon (Nasara: {arg1}, Hari daga {arg1}). Fixed characters (Akane, Yoru, Gorō, the heroes) may take ya/ta.
Hooked letters ɓ ɗ ƙ ƴ throughout (ƴan wasa, not 'yan wasa).

Generated names should use generatedNames: noun-first. Second parts carry the genitive linker of their own head noun (Kololuwar, Ƙofar, Kwarin), first parts are plain nouns (Tsawa, Ƙarfe, Hazo): Kololuwar Tsawa, Ƙofar Ƙarfe. With the default order they would read backwards.
Hausa letters ɓ ɗ ƙ ƴ are outside Latin-1, so Hausa needs the system font stack (SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS) at integration.
Japanese statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are fully translated into Hausa, following the Vietnamese pattern; the support page links them by their Japanese titles.
ui.s_have_bced00a61e ("s have") is an English plural fragment; ui.your_purchase_been_delivered uses {arg1, select, other {...}} so the fragment is not shown in Hausa.
